hadiths.arabic: أَحَبُّ الأَعْمَالِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَدْوَمُهَا وَإِنْ قَلَّ
hadiths.latin: Ahabbu-l-aʿmāli ilā-llāhi adwamuhā wa in qall
hadiths.en: The deeds most beloved to Allah are those done regularly, even if they are few.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ رَحْمَتِي سَبَقَتْ غَضَبِي
hadiths.latin: Inna raḥmatī sabaqat ghaḍabī
hadiths.en: Allah says: My mercy prevails over My wrath.

hadiths.arabic: يَسِّرُوا وَلاَ تُعَسِّرُوا وَبَشِّرُوا وَلاَ تُنَفِّرُوا
hadiths.latin: Yassirū wa lā tuʿassirū, wa bashshirū wa lā tunaffirū
hadiths.en: Make things easy and do not make them difficult; give glad tidings and do not repel.

hadiths.arabic: اتَّقِ اللَّهَ حَيْثُمَا كُنْتَ وَأَتْبِعِ السَّيِّئَةَ الْحَسَنَةَ تَمْحُهَا وَخَالِقِ النَّاسَ بِخُلُقٍ حَسَنٍ
hadiths.latin: Ittaqi-llāha ḥaythumā kunta, wa atbiʿi-s-sayyiʾata-l-ḥasanata tamḥuhā, wa khāliqi-n-nāsa bi-khuluqin ḥasan
hadiths.en: Fear Allah wherever you are; follow a bad deed with a good one and it will wipe it out; and treat people with good character.

hadiths.arabic: عَجَبًا لِأَمْرِ الْمُؤْمِنِ إِنَّ أَمْرَهُ كُلَّهُ خَيْرٌ
hadiths.latin: ʿAjaban li-amri-l-muʾmin, inna amrahu kullahu khayr
hadiths.en: How wonderful is the affair of the believer, for all his affairs are good.

hadiths.arabic: أَنَا عِنْدَ ظَنِّ عَبْدِي بِي وَأَنَا مَعَهُ إِذَا ذَكَرَنِي
hadiths.latin: Anā ʿinda ẓanni ʿabdī bī, wa anā maʿahu idhā dhakaranī
hadiths.en: Allah says: I am as My servant thinks I am, and I am with him when he remembers Me.

hadiths.arabic: الْمُؤْمِنُ الْقَوِيُّ خَيْرٌ وَأَحَبُّ إِلَى اللَّهِ مِنَ الْمُؤْمِنِ الضَّعِيفِ وَفِي كُلٍّ خَيْرٌ
hadiths.latin: Al-muʾminu-l-qawiyyu khayrun wa aḥabbu ilā-llāhi mina-l-muʾmini-ḍ-ḍaʿīf, wa fī kullin khayr
hadiths.en: The strong believer is better and more beloved to Allah than the weak believer, though there is good in both.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ سَلَكَ طَرِيقًا يَلْتَمِسُ فِيهِ عِلْمًا سَهَّلَ اللَّهُ لَهُ بِهِ طَرِيقًا إِلَى الْجَنَّةِ
hadiths.latin: Man salaka ṭarīqan yaltamisu fīhi ʿilman sahhala-llāhu lahu bihi ṭarīqan ilā-l-jannah
hadiths.en: Whoever travels a path in search of knowledge, Allah will make easy for him a path to Paradise.

hadiths.arabic: لاَ يُؤْمِنُ أَحَدُكُمْ حَتَّى يُحِبَّ لأَخِيهِ مَا يُحِبُّ لِنَفْسِهِ
hadiths.latin: Lā yuʾminu aḥadukum ḥattā yuḥibba li-akhīhi mā yuḥibbu li-nafsih
hadiths.en: None of you truly believes until he loves for his brother what he loves for himself.

hadiths.arabic: كُنْ فِي الدُّنْيَا كَأَنَّكَ غَرِيبٌ أَوْ عَابِرُ سَبِيلٍ
hadiths.latin: Kun fi-d-dunyā ka-annaka gharībun aw ʿābiru sabīl
hadiths.en: Be in this world as if you were a stranger or a traveler.

hadiths.arabic: لاَ تَحْقِرَنَّ مِنَ الْمَعْرُوفِ شَيْئًا وَلَوْ أَنْ تَلْقَى أَخَاكَ بِوَجْهٍ طَلْقٍ
hadiths.latin: Lā taḥqiranna mina-l-maʿrūfi shayʾan, wa law an talqā akhāka bi-wajhin ṭalq
hadiths.en: Do not belittle any good deed, even meeting your brother with a cheerful face.

hadiths.arabic: تَبَسُّمُكَ فِي وَجْهِ أَخِيكَ صَدَقَةٌ
hadiths.latin: Tabassumuka fī wajhi akhīka ṣadaqah
hadiths.en: Smiling in the face of your brother is an act of charity.

hadiths.arabic: أَكْمَلُ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِيمَانًا أَحْسَنُهُمْ خُلُقًا
hadiths.latin: Akmalu-l-muʾminīna īmānan aḥsanuhum khuluqā
hadiths.en: The most complete of believers in faith are those with the best character.

hadiths.arabic: لَيْسَ الْغِنَى عَنْ كَثْرَةِ الْعَرَضِ وَلَكِنَّ الْغِنَى غِنَى النَّفْسِ
hadiths.latin: Laysa-l-ghinā ʿan kathrati-l-ʿaraḍ, wa lākinna-l-ghinā ghina-n-nafs
hadiths.en: Richness is not having many possessions; rather, true richness is the contentment of the soul.

hadiths.arabic: إِنَّ اللَّهَ لاَ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى صُوَرِكُمْ وَأَمْوَالِكُمْ وَلَكِنْ يَنْظُرُ إِلَى قُلُوبِكُمْ وَأَعْمَالِكُمْ
hadiths.latin: Inna-llāha lā yanẓuru ilā ṣuwarikum wa amwālikum, wa lākin yanẓuru ilā qulūbikum wa aʿmālikum
hadiths.en: Allah does not look at your appearance or your wealth, but He looks at your hearts and your deeds.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ دَلَّ عَلَى خَيْرٍ فَلَهُ مِثْلُ أَجْرِ فَاعِلِهِ
hadiths.latin: Man dalla ʿalā khayrin fa-lahu mithlu ajri fāʿilih
hadiths.en: Whoever guides someone to good will have a reward like the one who does it.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ يُرِدِ اللَّهُ بِهِ خَيْرًا يُفَقِّهْهُ فِي الدِّينِ
hadiths.latin: Man yuridi-llāhu bihi khayran yufaqqihhu fi-d-dīn
hadiths.en: When Allah wishes good for someone, He gives him understanding of the religion.

hadiths.arabic: خَيْرُكُمْ مَنْ تَعَلَّمَ الْقُرْآنَ وَعَلَّمَهُ
hadiths.latin: Khayrukum man taʿallama-l-qurʾāna wa ʿallamah
hadiths.en: The best of you are those who learn the Qur'an and teach it.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ كَانَ يُؤْمِنُ بِاللَّهِ وَالْيَوْمِ الآخِرِ فَلْيَقُلْ خَيْرًا أَوْ لِيَصْمُتْ
hadiths.latin: Man kāna yuʾminu bi-llāhi wa-l-yawmi-l-ākhiri fa-l-yaqul khayran aw li-yaṣmut
hadiths.en: Whoever believes in Allah and the Last Day, let him speak good or remain silent.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ نَفَّسَ عَنْ مُؤْمِنٍ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ الدُّنْيَا نَفَّسَ اللَّهُ عَنْهُ كُرْبَةً مِنْ كُرَبِ يَوْمِ الْقِيَامَةِ
hadiths.latin: Man naffasa ʿan muʾminin kurbatan min kurabi-d-dunyā naffasa-llāhu ʿanhu kurbatan min kurabi yawmi-l-qiyāmah
hadiths.en: Whoever relieves a believer of a hardship in this world, Allah will relieve him of a hardship on the Day of Resurrection.

hadiths.arabic: مَنْ لاَ يَشْكُرُ النَّاسَ لاَ يَشْكُرُ اللَّهَ
hadiths.latin: Man lā yashkuru-n-nāsa lā yashkuru-llāh
hadiths.en: Whoever does not thank people has not thanked Allah.

hadiths.arabic: أَحَبُّ النَّاسِ إِلَى اللَّهِ أَنْفَعُهُمْ لِلنَّاسِ
hadiths.latin: Aḥabbu-n-nāsi ilā-llāhi anfaʿuhum li-n-nās
hadiths.en: The most beloved of people to Allah are those most beneficial to people.

hadiths.arabic: اغْتَنِمْ خَمْسًا قَبْلَ خَمْسٍ شَبَابَكَ قَبْلَ هَرَمِكَ وَصِحَّتَكَ قَبْلَ سَقَمِكَ
hadiths.latin: Ightanim khamsan qabla khams: shabābaka qabla haramik, wa ṣiḥḥataka qabla saqamik
hadiths.en: Take advantage of five before five: your youth before your old age, and your health before your sickness.

hadiths.arabic: الْكَلِمَةُ الطَّيِّبَةُ صَدَقَةٌ
hadiths.latin: Al-kalimatu-ṭ-ṭayyibatu ṣadaqah
hadiths.en: A good word is an act of charity.

hadiths.arabic: لَلَّهُ أَشَدُّ فَرَحًا بِتَوْبَةِ عَبْدِهِ حِينَ يَتُوبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ أَحَدِكُمْ
hadiths.latin: La-llāhu ashaddu faraḥan bi-tawbati ʿabdihi ḥīna yatūbu ilayhi min aḥadikum
hadiths.en: Allah rejoices more at the repentance of His servant than any of you would over finding what you had lost.

hadiths.arabic: لَنْ يُدْخِلَ أَحَدًا عَمَلُهُ الْجَنَّةَ وَلَكِنْ سَدِّدُوا وَقَارِبُوا
hadiths.latin: Lan yudkhila aḥadan ʿamaluhu-l-jannah, wa lākin saddidū wa qāribū
hadiths.en: No one's deeds alone will admit him to Paradise — it is by Allah's mercy — so aim true, draw near, and do not despair.
